snippet.title: OPUS: Prism Peak｜Release Date Trailer｜Nintendo Switch & Steam
snippet.description:
Mark your calendars: 4.16.2026 📅
OPUS: Prism Peak launches on Steam & Nintendo Switch 1 & Switch 2 !
We’re also thrilled to reveal an featured song composed by Kevin Penkin, known for Kusuriya no Hitorigoto, Made in Abyss, and Florence.
—-
Anyone you've photographed is a friend.
Let the spirits guide your path forward.

See you at the peak on March 26.
Wishlist Now https://utm.to/8mvyp6
